title: Complete core Chat conversation actions
goal: Make core Chat conversations more usable by letting users regenerate the latest answer without duplicating history and share either an individual answer or the visible conversation.
context: Chat already stores multi-turn conversations and streams responses. It lacks first-class actions to recover from an unsatisfactory answer and export useful conversation content without manually selecting text.
forbidden_changes: Do not modify provider routing or model loading in this feature task.
Do not weaken cancellation, authorization, privacy settings, or output validation.
Do not modify PersonalAgent.xcodeproj or unrelated runtime modules.
acceptance_criteria: A completed latest assistant turn can be regenerated from its preceding user prompt.
Regeneration replaces the previous user/assistant pair rather than duplicating the user message.
Users can share an individual assistant answer.
Users can export the currently visible conversation as readable speaker-labeled text.
Existing conversation persistence and the no-persistence privacy mode remain in effect.
verification: Review final diff and verify PR checks on the final head
recovery: Revert the single task commit if the Apple build or interaction review fails; do not create a separate repair commit.
